verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows Superpowers skills are plain, selectively installable markdown folders. They are copied verbatim into ./.claude/skills/, the installed SKILL.md can be read back cleanly, and the installer warns to 'Review skills before use'. The docs also say skills/ is the source of truth, shared verbatim across harnesses. Together this makes post-install reading straightforward, but Superpowers itself documents no pre-install content listing or review workflow. Its SessionStart hooks and bootstrap injection add behavior beyond the visible skill files, and no review path for that is documented. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install listing of files, instructions and scripts; review guidance covering hooks and bootstrap injection, not just SKILL.md; first-party docs (rather than a generic installer probe) on auditing installed content.
